# freeCodeCamp

> freeCodeCamp's design and brand reference guide covering typography, color systems, logos, and visual standards.

This style guide documents freeCodeCamp's design system and brand identity standards. It serves as the authoritative reference for maintaining visual consistency across the freeCodeCamp platform and community materials.

## Key Topics

- Design System
- Brand Standards
- Typography
- Color Palette
- Logo Guidelines
- Accent Colors
- Layout Colors
- Lato Font
- SaxMono Font
- Google Fonts
- Brand Guidelines

## Design System & Brand Standards

- [freeCodeCamp Style Guide](https://design-style-guide.freecodecamp.org/): Comprehensive design system and brand standards guide covering typography, color palettes, logo guidelines, and visual identity standards for freeCodeCamp.
